description: This file contains unit tests for the ExternalAnyKeyboard class in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It tests properties, keyboard loading, drawable states, code parsing, inner characters, and auto-capitalization behavior.

classes.name: ExternalAnyKeyboardTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ExternalAnyKeyboard, testing various functionalities such as properties, keyboard loading, drawable states, code parsing, inner characters, and auto-cap behavior.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test setup, obtaining application context and default add-on.

methods.name: testGeneralProperties
methods.description: Verifies basic properties of the created keyboard such as locale, name, ID, icon, and mode.

methods.name: testLoadedKeyboard
methods.description: Tests loading of the keyboard and verifies dimensions, keys, and shift key.

methods.name: testDrawableState
methods.description: Checks the drawable states of keys in different states (normal, pressed, functional).

methods.name: testCodesParsing
methods.description: Validates parsing of key codes and popup characters from XML configuration.

methods.name: testInnerCharacters
methods.description: Tests the recognition of inner word characters, including special and Unicode characters.

methods.name: testAutoCap
methods.description: Verifies the auto-capitalization setting behavior based on XML configurations.
